data.name: Hrushi
data.gender_notes: Hrushi is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A name derived from the Sanskrit word ‘hrusha’, which means ‘green plant’. Hrushi is a name that symbolizes growth, nourishment, and beauty. It is believed to bring wealth and prosperity to the person bearing this name. The name Hrushi carries the meaning “Green Plant, Wealth” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Hrushi usually hope their child will grow to embody green plant, wealth and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Represents the growth and expansion of consciousness. It is a reminder to nurture oneself and others, and to seek beauty in all aspects of life.
data.etymology: Hrushi belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Green Plant, Wealth.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Hrushi total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.

The name Hrushi can be thought of as a constant reminder of the inherent divine power of nature and the potential for renewal, growth, and self-realization within every individual.
